description: manni docs meta/ci/query-gates, run in a docs repo with docs/, authors/, and the page's two-collection config.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query "SELECT t.value tag, count(*) n FROM docs, json_each(docs.tags) t GROUP BY tag ORDER BY n DESC, tag" docs/

steps.description: The dangling-author rule joins the authors view; the row fails the check.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --check "SELECT d._path, d.author FROM docs d LEFT JOIN authors a ON a.slug = d.author WHERE d.author IS NOT NULL AND a._path IS NULL"

steps.description: The no-config spelling: a path self-join over bare inputs.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --check "SELECT d._path, d.author FROM docs d LEFT JOIN docs a ON a.slug = d.author AND a._path LIKE '%authors%' WHERE d._path LIKE '%docs%' AND d.author IS NOT NULL AND a._path IS NULL" docs/ authors/
npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --check "SELECT slug, count(*) n FROM docs GROUP BY slug HAVING n > 1" docs/
npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --check --param author=ghost "SELECT _path FROM docs WHERE author = :author" docs/

steps.description: Name the gate in config: write the page's checks: config.

runShell.command:
node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('manni.config.yaml','collections:
  - name: pages
    paths:
      - docs/**/*.md

meta:
  checks:
    - name: unique-slugs
      query: >-
        SELECT _path AS path, \x27slug\x27 AS key,
               \x27duplicate slug \x22\x27 || slug || \x27\x22\x27 AS message,
               lineFor(_path, \x27slug\x27) AS line
        FROM docs WHERE slug IN
          (SELECT slug FROM docs GROUP BY slug HAVING count(*) > 1)
')"

steps.description: A bare validate runs the check after the per-file schemas; each row is a finding.
-f github annotates the offending line of the offending file.
A scoped run skips checks with a stderr notice.

runShell.stdio: corpus checks skipped: run is scoped

steps.description: --format json prints the bare result array.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query "SELECT _path, title FROM docs WHERE draft = 1" docs/ -f json
npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query -f csv "SELECT _path, title, last_reviewed FROM docs WHERE _present = 1 ORDER BY _path" docs/ > stale.csv

steps.description: The CSV has its header row.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --dry-run "UPDATE docs SET reviewed = 'todo' WHERE reviewed IS NULL AND _present = 1" docs/
runShell.stdio: /docs/alpha\.md: reviewed: \(unset\) -> todo[\s\S]*3 changes across 3 files — dry run/
